name: FAQ, calm
description: One centred column of large, quiet questions without lines. The open question sits on a soft rounded tint.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Take your time. Here is what people usually ask.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: No question is too small. If yours is not here, ask us in whatever words you have.

itemFields.name: question
itemFields.label: Question
itemFields.default: What if I need to cancel?

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Answer
itemFields.default: Give us 48 hours and there is no charge.

default.question: What happens in a first session?
default.answer: We talk for 50 minutes about what brought you here and what you hope will change. There are no forms, and nothing you have to say before you are ready.

default.question: Is what I say confidential?
default.answer: Yes. Nothing leaves the room unless you or someone else is at serious risk, and even then we would talk with you first.

default.question: How many sessions will I need?
default.answer: Some people come for six weeks, others for a year. We look back together every sixth session, and you can stop whenever you choose.

default.question: How much does it cost?
default.answer: Sessions are £60. We keep four reduced-fee places at £35 for students and people on a low income.

default.question: Can we meet online?
default.answer: Yes. About a third of the people we see meet us by video, and you can move between the room and online from week to week.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Closing note
fields.default: Not sure counselling is for you? A 15-minute phone call is free and commits you to nothing.
